quests.title: The Book at Birrong
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the two in the afternoon out of Birrong runs on time. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

the two who follow you off it
$89 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of ES Marks
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. The last one through ES Marks carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Ride it to Kensington, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it. I'll see you right for it.

the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. A card ending 16 boards at Tallawong on the week of the show and vanishes. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Engadine Order
